name: job-agent
description: Open-source job-search skills: find and score roles, tailor your résumé, fill application forms on company sites and stop at Submit for you, keep a to-apply list, track applications and prep for interviews. Uses the TrueInterview MCP for live jobs, real interview data and your saved records when you sign in, and your own local files when you don't.
